title: Independent link-addressing oracle ignores key-derived Extended EUI-64 vector
description: link-addressing.json now includes key_derived_extended_eui64 for the Python/Rust interoperability correction, but test_protocol_vector_security.py checks only the arbitrary extended_eui64 case. Independently derive the key IID with SHA-512, flip the RFC 4291 U/L bit exactly once for wire EUI-64, validate the encoded frame destination, and reconstruct the expected link-local address.
